independent.scope: Seven original complete-call files supplied directly to the public-only checker frozen before the corpus. Private pilot diagnostics were not checker input; original clocks and all 1244 origin/call/end timestamps remain retained.

mechanics.kind: two periodic optical transmission masks sampled at shared world coordinates
mechanics.transmission: Each sinusoidal mask transmits (1 + cos(2 pi phase)) / 2. The displayed composite multiplies the two transmissions at each shared world point; all five current checks must pass together.
mechanics.controls: B switches the selected mask. Left/right slide its periodic phase; up/down rotate its angle. A submits the complete current five-point calibration. Held keys do not repeat.
mechanics.clockAndAttempts: 90 admitted model seconds and four rejected submissions. Deadline processing precedes input, so an acceptance at or beyond the deadline is not a win.
mechanics.visibleGuides: Public world fiducials show turn and slide errors for the current mask; past green checks do not accumulate.
mechanics.ordinaryPilot: The unchanged pilot responds to current public guide errors using ordinary input edges, with no target-control vector, route search or future-state prediction.

testNames: CommonJS/browser expose exactly the documented API and deeply frozen public configuration
creation normalizes without coercion and initializes the full fresh release-gated round
three authored tables and their central analytic measurements make all starts invalid

transmission has exact crests/troughs, negative periodicity and whole-cycle continuity
public optical helpers reject invalid coordinates/cycles without coercion or state reads
sampling multiplies two independent sinusoidal factors at the same rotated world point
left/right translate stripe crests physically left/right along their world normal
24 physical phase steps return exactly to the same samples across 23/0
rotation uses a common origin/sign, tangent, and free bounded stops on both sides
public signed guides use reference geometry and the half-cycle tie chooses physical Left
synthetic optical boundary: inclusive tolerance, either error sign, and no added epsilon
optical caches, public samples, canonical controls, config and separate rounds are detached
sampler and actual submission ignore deliberately corrupted synthetic optical caches
actual visible-guide policy reaches a simultaneous match on all three public tasks
previous passing probes are not banked when a later arrangement fails simultaneous submission
four actual rejected submissions at each untouched public start cause an exact bounded loss
correct fourth submission wins with three preserved failures and one remaining error allowance
submission and terminal snapshots are independent and later operations preserve earlier receipts
B switches without optical/budget changes and consumes simultaneous A/direction edges
A consumes a simultaneous direction, holding A permits fresh directions but never resubmits
strict threshold, clamp, vertical tie, held tokens and direct nonneutral changes are deterministic
fresh/retried held inputs remain inert until a later genuine neutral sample
epoch baseline/change and cancelled neutral enforce quarantine without stopping active time
only nonnegative safe epochs are stored and a changed neutral epoch arms the following edge
invalid duration is an exact no-op before descriptors or coercion
paused literal true normalizes every descriptor then preserves the entire round including deadline
normalization ignores accessors/inherited/pulse values and accepts only literal typed own data
prototype data/accessor pollution cannot enter temporary normalization storage
inherited coordinate accessors cannot intercept detached rejection or timeout receipt copying
arrays/functions/primitives become neutral and throwing descriptors discard all partial values atomically
accepted durations add once without accumulation/repeat, including tiny rounded additions
an actual untouched round times out after 360 admitted quarter-second calls
synthetic deadline ties/overshoots precede A/B/direction and preserve every gate field
synthetic accepted submission just before deadline wins while cancellation can still time out
terminal won/attempts/time states are exact no-ops before duration/input reads
synthetic saturating counters flag only attempted overflow and retain sticky status
